exposure: uterine artery embolization (UAE) in combination with dilatation and curettage (D&C)
bleeding group vs. control group (based on intraoperative hemorrhage)
outcome: changes in lesion volume, vascular index (VI), flow index (FI), blood vessels, and blood flow index (VFI) before and after UAE
finding: 3D ultrasonography, particularly VI and lesion volume, can help predict excessive bleeding during D&C after UAE in CSP patients.
